title: KBDoc
description: Liuye 5-protocol member · KBDoc (v3 spec §2.4). Knowledge-base document metadata · referenced by EvidenceRef.kb_doc_id. tier 1-4 per root §3.5.1 data tier hierarchy (Tier 1 internal authoritative → Tier 4 public web · core-claim ban on Tier 4 alone). pipl_region tracks PIPL cross-border data residency · cn = mainland · overseas = ex-mainland (audit log required per root §3.6).

id.description: Stable KBDoc identifier · referenced by EvidenceRef.kb_doc_id.

schema_version.description: Liuye contract schema version · fixed '1' for the current spec lock.

title.description: Human-readable document title shown in KB browser and evidence panel.

type.description: KBDoc provenance type. upload = RM/审贷员 manual upload · pulled = SearchProvider auto-fetch (Tavily/akshare/gov_cn/...) · mock = fixture/demo data (反 5 原则 §3.5 boundary).

tier.description: Data tier 1-4 (v3 §2.4 line 228 verbatim · maps to root §3.5.1 DataTier enum). 1=internal_authoritative (bank internal · 100% trust) · 2=government (银保监/央行/税务/法院 · <30d freshness) · 3=industry (上市公告/评级/研报) · 4=public_web (新闻/Tavily · core-claim ban). NOTE: v3 uses int tier · shared/data_tiers.DataTier is a str enum (internal_authoritative/government/industry/public_web) · mapping done at consumer adapter (int 1↔internal_authoritative etc).

source_type.description: Source channel type (v3 §2.4 line 229 verbatim). gov = government portal · enterprise = enterprise registry (qichacha/tianyancha) · tavily = Tavily web search · internal = bank internal system (CRM/流水/征信) · user = RM/审贷员 uploaded doc.

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC · when we fetched/received this doc. Maps to recommendation_schema.retrieved_at semantics.

valid_until.description: Optional · document validity expiry (e.g. signed PDF cert expiry · government notice retraction date).

verification_method.description: Verification level (v3 §2.4 line 232 verbatim). signature = digital signature verified (PDF/PKCS#7) · cross_check = multi-source corroborated · manual = human-verified · unverified = raw fetch with no verification (typical for tavily/web).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 content hash · 64 lowercase hex chars (v3 §2.4 line 233 verbatim). Used for KB dedup and tamper detection. Recomputed on re-fetch · mismatch triggers freshness invalidation.

pipl_region.description: PIPL cross-border residency (v3 §2.4 line 234 verbatim · root §3.6 PIPL fallback chain). cn = mainland data residency · overseas = ex-mainland (US/SG/...). Required for audit log when LLM call routes overseas (moonshot/openai). Optional in KBDoc since most internal docs are cn by default · explicit overseas marker for compliance trace.
